findings.summary: The slot overload sets contentDescription with Modifier.semantics, so the avatar's initials Text still merges into the button node and TalkBack reads 'Open account drawer, DU'. Maestro flow 03 relies on 'DU' being visible, so leave it unless the label should be clean (clearAndSetSemantics on the avatar would remove the text node).

The brief asked for .maestro/files-chrome/; the branch adds none and the 6/6 run used the test-plan flows committed on main at 9d775b0. Fine as long as the merge step treats docs/workflow/flows as the device proof.

Touches a file outside its likely_files (and outside delete-item's list) in the module delete-item edits; a one-line, justified change, so merge conflicts are unlikely. No file in delete-item's likely_files is touched and no DeleteSnackbar* PNG is affected.
